sizeGuide.title: Size guide
sizeGuide.subtitle: EU, UK and US conversions with body measurements in centimetres.
sizeGuide.returns: Still unsure? Order two sizes and return the one that does not fit — returns are free within 30 days.

notes.clothingMen: Measure across the chest at its fullest point, over a light layer. Between sizes, size up for a relaxed fit.
notes.clothingWomen: Measure the bust at its fullest point and the waist at its narrowest. UK and US sizes differ by two — check both columns.
notes.clothingUnisex: Cut to a men's block. If you usually wear women's sizes, choose one size down from your usual.
notes.clothingKids: Choose by height first and age second — children of the same age vary widely. Between sizes, size up.
notes.footwear: Measure from heel to longest toe while standing, in the afternoon. Sizes run true; wide feet may prefer a half size up.
notes.footwearUnisex: Unisex footwear is numbered on the men's scale. Women should typically take 1.5 US sizes down from their usual.
notes.footwearKids: Leave about 1 cm of growing room beyond the longest toe. Check the fit every three months.
notes.trousers: Sizes are the waist measurement in inches. Measure around your natural waistline, not over the hips.
notes.belts: Belt size is the length in centimetres to the middle hole. Choose roughly 10 cm above your trouser waist.
